{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wistie Dance''' was a dance performed by the [[Ewok]]s during the [[Festival of the Wisties|Festival]] of the [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]]. It was accompanied by the sound of rattles, which could be made from [[gwanda gourd]]s.
